stories.title: The Last Train North
stories.preview: A station clock stops, but one train keeps moving.

nodes.title: Platform Zero
nodes.content: At 00:17 every clock in the station stopped. Only the departure board continued to turn, spelling a destination that did not exist on any map.

nodes.title: Follow the snow
nodes.content: Snow drifted through the open carriage without melting. On each seat lay a postcard addressed in the passenger's own handwriting.

nodes.title: Ask the signal keeper
nodes.content: The signal keeper carried no lamp, only a jar filled with summer light. He said the train arrived whenever someone finally chose to leave.

nodes.title: Read the postcard
nodes.content: The card described tomorrow with unnerving precision, ending one sentence before the choice she now had to make.

stories.title: The Glass Garden
stories.preview: Every plant remembers the voice that named it.

nodes.title: A borrowed key
nodes.content: The greenhouse had been locked for thirty years. Still, every Thursday, someone left a warm cup of tea beside its door.
